cases.source: The archive accepts batches of no more than thirty files. A batch of twenty files is proposed.
cases.transformation: The archive accepts batches of no more than forty files. A batch of twenty files is proposed.

obligations.source_quote: The archive accepts batches of no more than thirty files.

cases.source: The review queue accepts batches of no more than twelve items.
cases.transformation: The review queue accepts batches of fewer than twelve items.

obligations.source_quote: The review queue accepts batches of no more than twelve items.

cases.source: Escalation is permitted after at least ten continuous minutes of lag. The dashboard shows twelve minutes.
cases.transformation: Escalation is permitted after more than ten continuous minutes of lag. The dashboard shows twelve minutes.

obligations.source_quote: Escalation is permitted after at least ten continuous minutes of lag.

cases.source: Paging is permitted after five minutes. Restarting requires separate approval.
cases.transformation: Paging is permitted after five minutes. Restarting requires no approval.

obligations.source_quote: Paging is permitted after five minutes.
Restarting requires separate approval.

cases.source: The key may be used during an incident, except when the incident ticket is closed.
cases.transformation: The key may be used during an incident, except when the incident is unresolved.

obligations.source_quote: except when the incident ticket is closed

cases.source: The vendor may access the portal only if the security review is complete and the access ticket is approved. The security review is complete. The access ticket is not approved.
cases.transformation: The vendor may access the portal because the security review is complete.
cases.purpose: Communicate whether the vendor may access the portal.

obligations.source_quote: only if the security review is complete and the access ticket is approved

cases.source: The note records a failed checksum. It does not grant deletion authority.
cases.transformation: The operator may delete the replica without further approval.

obligations.source_quote: It does not grant deletion authority.

cases.source: The vendor approval has not been decided. The record contains neither approval nor denial.
cases.transformation: The vendor is approved; the record contains the approval.

obligations.source_quote: The vendor approval has not been decided.

cases.source: Reviewer: "The rollout is approved." Chair: "The test plan is approved."
cases.transformation: Chair: "The rollout is approved." Reviewer: "The test plan is approved."

obligations.source_quote: Reviewer: "The rollout is approved."
Chair: "The test plan is approved."

cases.source: The reviewer approved the plan. The note does not say whether "the plan" means the rollout plan or the test plan.
cases.transformation: The reviewer approved the rollout plan.

obligations.source_quote: The note does not say whether "the plan" means the rollout plan or the test plan.

cases.source: The checksum failed during transfer. The investigation says the cause has not been verified.
cases.transformation: The checksum failure caused the replica to become stale; the investigation confirmed the cause.

obligations.source_quote: The investigation says the cause has not been verified.

cases.source: The archive team is authorised to delete legal-hold records. The approval is recorded.
cases.transformation: It is unclear whether the archive team is authorised to delete legal-hold records.

obligations.source_quote: The archive team is authorised to delete legal-hold records.

cases.source: The operator may retrieve the key only if the ticket is open and the audit log remains intact.
cases.transformation: Provided the ticket stays open and the audit log is unaltered, the operator is allowed to retrieve the key.

obligations.source_quote: only if the ticket is open and the audit log remains intact

cases.source: The release requires an accepted security review and an approved ticket.
cases.transformation: An approved ticket and an accepted security review are required.

obligations.source_quote: The release requires an accepted security review and an approved ticket.

cases.source: The vendor may keep the copy for fourteen days only if the privacy review is complete. The vendor must delete it afterwards.
cases.transformation: Subject to completion of the privacy review, the vendor may keep the copy for no more than fourteen days and must delete it afterwards.
cases.purpose: Qualified summary of the retention rules.

obligations.source_quote: The vendor may keep the copy for fourteen days only if the privacy review is complete.
The vendor must delete it afterwards.

cases.source: During an outage, operators may copy the backup credential into a temporary isolated terminal.
cases.transformation: During an outage, operators are allowed to duplicate the recovery key into a standalone diagnostic terminal.

obligations.source_quote: operators may copy the backup credential into a temporary isolated terminal

cases.source: The incident desk may page the engineer when lag exceeds twenty seconds for five minutes. The dashboard shows nine minutes. Office badges are irrelevant.
cases.transformation: The incident desk may page the engineer when lag exceeds twenty seconds for five minutes; the dashboard shows nine minutes.

obligations.source_quote: The incident desk may page the engineer when lag exceeds twenty seconds for five minutes.

cases.source: The checksum failed during transfer. The investigation says the cause has not been verified.
cases.transformation: The checksum failed during transfer; the investigation has not verified the cause.

obligations.source_quote: The investigation says the cause has not been verified.

cases.source: Paging is permitted after five minutes. Restarting requires separate approval.
cases.transformation: Restarting requires separate approval. Paging is permitted after five minutes.

obligations.source_quote: Paging is permitted after five minutes.
Restarting requires separate approval.

cases.source: The vendor must delete the copy afterwards. It must keep the audit log intact.
cases.transformation: The vendor must delete the copy afterwards and must keep the audit log intact.
cases.purpose: Preserve two obligations with a sentence-initial pronoun.

obligations.source_quote: It must keep the audit log intact.

cases.source: The privacy team has not decided whether vendor replication is authorised. The record contains neither approval nor denial.
cases.transformation: It remains unclear whether vendor replication is authorised.

obligations.source_quote: The privacy team has not decided whether vendor replication is authorised.

cases.source: Requests timestamped after 17:00 are outside the exception. The system recorded the request at 18:00. It is unclear whether 18:00 is the request timestamp or only the recording time.
cases.transformation: It is unclear whether the request was timestamped after 17:00, because 18:00 may be the recording time.

obligations.source_quote: It is unclear whether 18:00 is the request timestamp or only the recording time.

cases.source: The reviewer approved the plan. The note does not say whether "the plan" means the rollout plan or the test plan.
cases.transformation: It remains unclear which plan the reviewer approved.

obligations.source_quote: The note does not say whether "the plan" means the rollout plan or the test plan.

cases.source: The image signature was verified. The policy requires a signed known-good image.
cases.transformation: It is unclear whether the image is known-good despite the verified signature.

obligations.source_quote: The policy requires a signed known-good image.
